body:
I am seeing "^M" characters at the end of the lines when live grepping. I am on windows and these files do in fact have CRLF line endings, but I noticed that telescope removes them somehow.

How can we remove CRLF characters so they don't show when live grepping?

Thanks!

I am afraid, I don't have Windows, so we'd have to do a little pair investigation, if you don't mind. Here are initial questions:

- Would you mind comparing how executing `rg` looks in 'mini.pick' and manually in terminal emulator? Here is the ideal info:
    - Start `MiniPick.builtin.live_grep`, type some `pattern`, and make a screenshot.
    - Open terminal emulator (in the same current working directory) and execute `rg --column --line-number --no-heading --field-match-separator \\x00 --no-follow --color=never -- pattern` (replace `pattern` with pattern you used in previous step) and make a screenshot. Order of items might change, but that's ok. I am curious whether there are extra `^M` at the end there.
- What is the output of the following command (that prints values of certain options): `:echo &fileformat &fixendofline` ?

My guess (and hope) that this can be fixed with some `rg` flag, like `--crlf`. But not sure.

reply_data.body:
> fzf-lua seems to strip the crlf endings just fine

Yes, because it seems to [adjust that during file reading regardless of platform](https://github.com/ibhagwan/fzf-lua/blob/8e6a1e9f92b531ee965db4713c0227aeb37b4a22/lua/fzf-lua/previewer/builtin.lua#L841). I think I'd like a more OS robust approach if it is possible.

> Do we need to post-process the results somehow to convert the crlf to lf endings?

Yes, adjusting how items are shown was next step. Would you mind, please, checking two possible solutions to this? Apply each of these independently from one another:
- Replace [this line](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/7ebfab26d77a4b9b05aaae565907e7fa4b2ee154/lua/mini/pick.lua#L1711) with `    local items = vim.split(table.concat(data_feed), H.is_windows and '\r\n' or '\n')`. This one adjusts how lines are separated when getting results from CLI.
- Replace [this line](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/7ebfab26d77a4b9b05aaae565907e7fa4b2ee154/lua/mini/pick.lua#L1064) with `  lines = vim.tbl_map(function(l) return l:gsub('%z', '│'):gsub('\r$', ''):gsub('[\n\r]', ' '):gsub('\t', tab_spaces) end, lines)`. This one adjusts how items are shown.

My hope is that both work, but you never know.
